selection_policy: From 106 eligible Windows host ZIP captures with non-placeholder ATT&CK ground truth, select 40 without inspecting detector results: use fixed tactic quotas, take the smallest capture for each distinct primary technique first, then fill each quota by compressed size. This spans every represented Windows tactic except the repository's uncategorized 'other' bucket.
license_observation: At the pinned commit LICENSE contains the MIT License, while README.md still says GPL-3.0. Captures stay in an external sparse checkout and are not redistributed here.
